title: Apex of the lofty cone
html_source: Prospect Cemetery is located in Glasnevin, although better known as Glasnevin Cemetery, the most historically notable burial place in the country. The cemetery contains historically notable monuments and the graves of many of Ireland’s most prominent national figures including Daniel O'Connell. His grave in Glasnevin Cemetery, Ireland’s most famous one, is marked by a 52 meter high Round Tower. This is the tallest of all the Round Towers in Ireland.
